strategy: Cross-sectional funding carry; low trailing funding long / high trailing funding short
source: Official free Binance Vision USD-M Futures monthly fundingRate and 1h klines

methodology.selection: lowest 20% funding long; highest 20% funding short
methodology.fees: one-way fee charged on actual traded notional turnover
methodology.funding: realized funding cashflow applied at each settlement to positions held before settlement
methodology.price: 1h kline close at/just before each funding settlement
methodology.timing: rank after settlement using trailing completed funding, then hold into next interval
methodology.splits: chronological 50% train / 20% validation / 30% OOS; fixed rule, no OOS tuning
limitations: Static major-coin universe has survivorship bias; delisted contracts are not yet included.
Hourly close is a proxy for executable mark/index price at settlement.
No intraday rebalance, liquidation, margin interest, or market impact model.
Backtest is research only; no live orders or API keys.
